name: browser
description: Drive a real browser from duya: search, read and extract from web pages, fill forms and complete multi-step interactions, and capture screenshots for visual verification. The engine ships inside duya as @duya/browser — this plugin adds the scenario knowledge (how to research, how to automate) and its permission policy, not a second browser.

interface.shortDescription: Search, read, extract and automate on real web pages
interface.longDescription: Use duya's built-in browser to work with live web pages. The `browser` tool drives a real Chromium session over CDP and degrades gracefully (extension -> sidebar webview -> static fetch) when a transport is unavailable. This plugin contributes the operating knowledge: when to snapshot instead of guessing selectors, how to verify that a write actually landed, and how to research a topic across many sources without losing provenance. The engine is part of duya, so there is nothing to install, no binary to download and no account to connect. Read the `browser` tool's usage guide (via tool_catalog) before the first call — it documents every operation and its failure modes.
